#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Ximena Giesemann] (Doctoral Candidate, Claremont Graduate University) – [Monday, September 23, 2024 at 11:16:32 PM]:**  
  - Reported an issue with a participant not receiving survey notifications for research project (ID: 4055).  
  - *Key quote:* "One of the participants told me that they have not received notifications to complete surveys."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Support, Avicenna) – [Tuesday, September 24, 2024 at 1:29 AM]:**  
  - Requested additional information to troubleshoot the issue: participant's phone model, custom activities/notifications, and participant ID.  
  - *Key quote:* "Can you please provide us with more information?"  

- **[Ximena Giesemann] (Doctoral Candidate, Claremont Graduate University) – [Wednesday, September 25, 2024 at 6:43:25 PM]:**  
  - Resolved the notification issue independently.  
  - Inquired about displaying multiple survey questions per page instead of one per page.  
  - *Key quote:* "I was actually able to figure out the issue, luckily."  

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Support, Avicenna) – [Thursday, September 26, 2024 at 3:26 AM]:**  
  - Confirmed the multi-question feature is planned for release in early 2025.  
  - *Key quote:* "We currently don't have this option, but it is in our plan."  

- **[Ximena Giesemann] (Doctoral Candidate, Claremont Graduate University) – [Saturday, September 28, 2024 at 2:09:16 AM]:**  
  - Acknowledged the response and expressed interest in the future feature.  
  - *Key quote:* "Looking forward to being able to use that feature!"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Support, Avicenna) – [Monday, September 30, 2024 at 1:40 AM]:**  
  - Reiterated the Q1 2025 timeline for the multi-question feature and offered to close the ticket.  
  - *Key quote:* "Please have an eye out on our release note to see the multiple question in one page feature."  

- **[Ximena Giesemann] (Doctoral Candidate, Claremont Graduate University) – [Tuesday, October 1, 2024 at 10:02:32 PM]:**  
  - Approved closing the ticket.  
  - *Key quote:* "Yes, please feel free to close the ticket."
